c: p:otonari no tenshi-sama ni itsunomanika dame ningen ni sareteita ken
d: Amane is throwing a house party. He wants to do something nice for Mahiru, and since he knows she loves serving others, he invites his male acquaintances. Wanting to please everyone, Mahiru wears nothing but an apron, and as everyone hangs out, her true self starts to come out.
